Elevate your cannabis experience with Chronic Guru’s premium concentrate—Live Rosin. Known for its purity and rich terpene profile, this solventless extract offers a clean and potent journey into cannabis refinement. Whether you’re new to concentrates or a seasoned enthusiast, this product delivers unmatched flavor, potency, and authenticity.

Read the full profile
What Makes It Special?
Full-Spectrum Cannabinoids
Preserving the natural balance of cannabinoids and terpenes, this concentrate reflects the plant’s essence for an authentic and diverse profile.

Fresh Extraction Process
Made from uncured, fresh cannabis, the product bursts with natural aroma and flavor, providing a truly rich experience.

Chemical-Free Production
Created without solvents, it guarantees a pure and clean product, free from residual chemicals.

Why Choose Our Premium Concentrate?
Top-Tier Quality
Rigorous lab testing ensures safety, purity, and consistent results for every batch.

Vibrant Flavors and Aromas
The extraction method retains the original terpenes, offering bold flavors that stand out.

Versatile Use
Whether you dab, vape, or infuse your edibles, this product adapts to suit your preferred consumption method.

How to Enjoy It
Dabbing:
Use a dab rig to vaporize for intense and fast-acting effects.

Vaping:
A concentrate-compatible vaporizer delivers clean and flavorful vapor.

Infusing Edibles:
Incorporate into oils or butter to add a rich cannabinoid profile to your favorite recipes.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is it?
A solventless concentrate made from fresh cannabis, preserving the plant’s natural properties.

How should it be stored?
Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dark location to maintain freshness and potency.

Is it suitable for beginners?
Yes, beginners can start with small doses to gauge their tolerance and enjoy the product responsibly.

How does this differ from other concentrates?
It’s extracted without solvents, ensuring a clean and natural experience free from residual chemicals.

Introducing the GeekVape H45 Classic 45W Vape Kit, exuding the classic Aegis aesthetic and designed to fit perfectly in your hand. This kit features the H45 Classic Device, which comes with a built-in 1400mAh battery and a wattage output range of 5W to 45W. The device boasts an ultra-lightweight design, making it 15% lighter than the previous generation. It is also IP68 rated, ensuring durability and reliability. The top airflow leakproof design enhances its convenience and usability.

The H45 Pod has a 4mL capacity and supports top filling, adjustable airflow, and a removable coil method for easy maintenance. Each kit includes the H45 Classic Device, H45 Pod 4mL, spare MTL drip tip, two B Series Coils, a USB Type-C cable, and a coil tool.

For vape shop owners looking to offer their customers a reliable and high-performance vape kit, the GeekVape H45 Classic 45W Vape Kit is an excellent addition to any product lineup.

Dimensions: 44.8mm X 30mm X 92mm.

products.name: RP43 (AKA Richard Petty) THCa Flower
products.description:
What happens when DNA Genetics releases their most prized elite clone to the public? You get RP43 THCa Flower—18% of pure, gassy perfection that earned its place in the vault for a reason. Named after “The King” Richard Petty, winner of 200 NASCAR races, this strain is a champion in every sense. This is the genetics that serious connoisseurs whisper about. The one that’s been used to create other legendary crosses.

Ready to experience what happens when DNA Genetics shares their secret weapon?

The genetics that earned elite status

RP43 started as a one-of-a-kind phenotype that DNA Genetics’ expert breeders selected for its exceptional indica traits, massive resin production, and unforgettable aroma. It performed so well in test grows that it earned “elite clone” status—the highest honor in their genetic vault. The nickname “Richard Petty” pays tribute to the racing legend who dominated NASCAR in car #43, because this strain dominates everything it’s crossed with.

What does this mean for you? You’re smoking the same genetics that DNA Genetics guards closely and uses as a breeding parent for new hybrids. The S1 self-pollination process preserves every characteristic of the original elite clone—nothing lost, nothing diluted. When you buy RP43, you’re getting the real thing, the same champion that earned its place among DNA’s most prized cultivars.

Taste the high-octane

The first thing you’ll notice? That unmistakable gasoline aroma that announces itself the moment you crack the seal. Pungent, deeply dank, and impossible to ignore—this is fuel-forward cannabis for those who appreciate bold profiles. Gearheads will love the petroleum punch, backed by earthy depth that grounds the experience.

The flavor profile is surprisingly smooth despite the aggressive nose. Initial hits deliver that signature diesel with spicy undertones from dominant caryophyllene. Mid-session brings earthy humulene notes forward—like a damp forest floor after rain. The finish? Subtle citrus brightness from limonene that lifts the entire experience. This isn’t one-dimensional gas. This is a complex terpene symphony powered by myrcene, limonene, humulene, and caryophyllene working in perfect harmony.

The high that takes the checkered flag

Here’s what makes RP43 special: it races through phases like Petty through a speedway. The initial onset hits with surprising energy—euphoric, creative, focus-sharpening. Some say it reduces inhibitions, making social situations more enjoyable. You’ll feel motivated, engaged, and ready to tackle whatever’s in front of you.

But here’s where The King shows its true colors: as the initial lap completes, deep relaxation takes the wheel. Your body settles into profound comfort. Limbs grow heavy. Eyelids follow. The indica dominance reveals itself in full force, delivering that championship-level body calm that serious consumers crave. This makes RP43 THCa flower perfect for evening use or days off when you can let the full experience unfold.

Users describe the transition as seamless—creative energy giving way to blissful sedation without jarring shifts. It’s perfect for those seeking serious relaxation, potential help with sleep difficulties, or simply wanting to experience what elite genetics feel like. Medical cannabis patients particularly appreciate how it addresses tension, restlessness, and appetite challenges.

Visual appeal meets vault-worthy genetics

Open your package and understand why this strain earned elite status. RP43 buds showcase classic indica structure—dense, compact nugs with a thick, bushy appearance that speaks to its heritage. Deep green coloring contrasts with glistening trichome coverage that coats every surface like morning frost on race day.

This isn’t just beautiful flower. At 18% THCa, you’re looking at potency that matches the pedigree. Every bud is sticky with resin production that made this clone famous, hand-trimmed to perfection, and cured to preserve that signature gas profile. When you buy RP43 THCa flower, you’re choosing genetics that DNA Genetics trusted enough to keep in their vault—and trusted enough to breed their next generation of champions.

Why RP43 delivers

The answer is simple: elite clone genetics, unforgettable gas flavor, championship relaxation. This strain represents DNA Genetics at their most exclusive—releasing a closely guarded phenotype that earned its place through performance, not marketing.

You get the pungent gasoline profile that serious connoisseurs demand. You get the phased effects that start creative and finish sedating. You get 18% THCa that’s lab-tested, compliant, and backed by elite genetics. Most importantly, you get access to the same strain that DNA Genetics uses as a foundation for future champions.

This is the strain for cannabis veterans who appreciate pedigree. For indica lovers seeking serious relaxation. For anyone who believes their flower should have a story worth telling.

Experience The King

RP43 THCa Flower isn’t just another hemp product. It’s a piece of DNA Genetics history—an elite clone that earned its nickname through dominance, finally available to consumers who appreciate what “vault-worthy” really means.

The pungent gas aroma that announces quality before you light up. The euphoric onset that transitions into deep body calm. The sedating finish that makes evenings disappear into comfort. The dense, resin-coated buds that look like they belong in a breeder’s private collection. Every element of this strain says elite.

Don’t settle for ordinary flower when you can smoke royalty. Add RP43 to your collection and discover why this strain earned the right to be called The King.

RP43 THCa Flower—named after NASCAR legend Richard Petty and his iconic #43 car—delivers 18% THCa of pure, high-octane indica power that starts with euphoric energy and finishes with championship-level relaxation. This isn't just premium hemp flower—it's DNA Genetics' secret weapon, an elite clone finally available to the public.
